text.p: PRAVDA - Slovak Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar will pay an official visit to France in March, at the invitation of French Premier Alain Juppe.
- Shipmaker Slovenske Lodenice a.s. has built a total of 1,629 boats during the 98 years of the company's existence. The company plans to build 14 sea-going cargo ships this year.

NARODNA OBRODA - According to the International Monetary Fund, the Slovak economy has been showing signs of overheating, which is allegedly confirmed by a considerable worsening of the balance of payments account.
PRACA - Slovakia has a worse chance of integration into western structures, including the EU and OECD, than its central European neighbours, president Michal Kovac said.

SLOVENSKA REPUBLIKA - Slovakia believes it will win the Gabcikovo-Nagymaros dam trial against Hungary before the Hague International Court. Hungary halted previously agreed construction works on the project in 1989, forcing Slovakia to continue alone at considerable cost.

HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Commercial bank Polnobanka a.s. opened its new, 33rd branch in Trencin, western Slovakia. The bank provides some 80 percent of its overall loans to the private sector. These loans were worth more than 16 billion crowns last year.

- Container transport company INTRANS a.s. will deliver more than 24,000 tonnes of freight to the Community of Independent States (CIS) this year. INTRANS, the first Slovak firm dealing with container transport to Russia, is expected to provide at least one train a week.
